changelog: Multi-Storage Cloud Engine: Seamlessly distributed ~20 GB mod asset library across dual Cloudflare R2 buckets.
Smart Routing & Fallback: Intelligent origin detection per file with automatic secondary endpoint fallback.
Enhanced Security: Reinforced authentication headers (X-Launcher-Auth) and client integrity validation.
Full Asset Compatibility: Complete support for updated convoy maps, bus mods, chassis physics, and custom liveries.
Performance Optimization: Streamlined concurrent bucket probing and background update checks.
